extraction.notes: Three-month Q4 2023 column used from the FFO, Core FFO and AFFO reconciliation (page 24). All subtotals tie: 18,421 + adjustments = 17,768 FFO; 17,768 + adjustments = 17,409 Core FFO; 17,409 + adjustments = 20,132 AFFO. Diluted shares of 26,298 reproduce reported per-share figures (FFO 0.68, Core FFO 0.66, AFFO 0.77). The reconciliation starts from net income of 18,421, which differs from the 18,351 net income attributable to common stockholders in the highlights on page 8; the reconciliation's own starting line was used. The 'Gain on forfeited deposits' line shows a dash for the Q4 2023 column and was omitted. AFFO does not deduct recurring capex, so the Q4 2023 recurring maintenance capex of 1,356 is taken from the Historical Capital Expenditures table on page 25.
